draft.briefing: Hey, you're in Canacona, or Kankon as locals say! This is Goa's southernmost taluka, and Chaudi is its headquarters. Its beach belt, including Palolem, Patnem and Agonda, was only 'discovered' after the 1990s.
draft.hungryLine: Head to Palolem beach, where Goan dishes, fish tandoor and fresh juices are the local favourites.

moodReplies.show-me-around: Visit Mallikarjun Temple, 2.5 km from Chaudi, then the five centuries old Parthagal math.
moodReplies.somewhere-to-chill: Seek out one of Canacona's nearly 20 lesser-known beaches, no hotels, no restaurants, just quiet.
moodReplies.surprise-me: Chaudi gets its name from the chavdi, the hall where each comunidade's village elders met to make big decisions.

spots.name: Mallikarjun Temple
spots.detail: 2.5 km from Chaudi · Devotees come for advice from the oracles

spots.name: Parthagal math
spots.detail: Short drive · A monastery five centuries old

spots.name: Cotigao Wildlife Sanctuary

legends.title: Answers in the petals
legends.body: Devotees come to Mallikarjun Temple for advice from the oracles. The answer is read from where the flower petals drop.

legends.title: The sage Kanva's town
legends.body: Some traditional accounts link the region to the name Kanvapura and the sage Kanva. Goa University research calls this one of several traditions about how Kankon got its name.

tips.title: Get your own wheels.
tips.body: Public buses are few and far between, so a bike or car makes reaching the beaches and fort much easier.

tips.title: Time an Anjediva trip.
tips.body: Visits to Anjediva Island usually happen around October or February, during local feasts.

story.title: Betal of Loliem
story.body: In Loliem, a statue of Betal, possibly a pre-Hindu deity, goes back to the seventh century if not earlier. The village also has centuries-old 'hero' stones recording old events.

story.title: Village halls
story.body: Each comunidade had a hall called a chavdi or chaudi, where elders made important decisions. Chaudi kept its importance and became the taluka's main town.

story.title: Kankon becomes Canacona
story.body: Kankon is the local form of the name. Canacona is the form the Portuguese used, and it stuck in later administration.

story.title: The beach belt
story.body: Canacona's beaches were 'discovered' only after the 1990s. Palolem and Agonda remain not overdeveloped, with dolphin-watching and fishing trips drawing visitors.

food.name: Palolem Beach Resort
food.detail: Dilip Gaitonde's place right on the beach, Goan dishes are the favourites

food.name: Silver Star
food.detail: Go for the fish tandoor or a sizzler
